title: Malik Nabers is a Giants Week 5 question mark after missing practice

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Malik Nabers is a Giants Week 5 question mark after missing practice
sources.description: “We’ll see how the next day goes, but through the week I’ll usually be sore,” Nabers said. “But this one was kind of a little bit more sore. But I always continue to fight through it.”
